headline: Sanathan Textiles announces postal ballot notice for shareholders
hook: Postal ballot notice issued for Sanathan
summary: Sanathan Textiles Limited has submitted a notice of postal ballot dated October 15, 2026, to the stock exchange. Shareholders will be required to vote on specific corporate resolutions through this remote voting process. The company is proceeding with procedural governance matters as per regulatory norms. Indian retail investors holding the stock should review the ballot details to participate in the upcoming corporate decisions.
why_it_matters: Vote on upcoming corporate resolutions as a shareholder.

headline: Sanathan Textiles releases calendar of events for postal ballot
summary: Sanathan Textiles Limited has officially notified the exchange regarding the schedule of events for its upcoming postal ballot process. This administrative filing outlines the timeline for shareholder voting on corporate resolutions. The update is a procedural step required for company governance and corporate actions. Indian retail investors tracking Sanathan Textiles can note the timeline for upcoming shareholder decisions.
why_it_matters: Procedural update with no immediate financial impact on shares.

headline: Sanathan Textiles announces change in company director
summary: Sanathan Textiles Limited has officially informed the stock exchange regarding a change in its board of directors. The announcement details routine board-level transitions within the company. Such corporate governance updates are procedural requirements for listed entities.
